service_boundary: Represents Workers AI inference, not Cloudflare AI Gateway, Vectorize, Workers runtime generally, model publishers, or customer-hosted GPU infrastructure.
regional_controls: Inference runs on Cloudflare's distributed network; the reviewed public product is not represented as a customer-selected single-region endpoint service.
retention_controls: Cloudflare's developer-platform terms and Workers AI data guidance govern request handling; AI Gateway logging is a separate optional service boundary.
routing: Customers select models from the Workers AI catalog; AI Gateway provider routing is a separate product.
customization: Fine-tunes and model catalog features are model-specific; arbitrary customer weight deployment is not claimed here.
strengths: Inference can be invoked directly from Cloudflare Workers near application logic.
A serverless API removes endpoint-capacity management for supported models.
tradeoffs: The model catalog is curated rather than arbitrary.
Distributed execution is different from fixed-region residency.
